tasks.label: PlatformIO: Clean, Build, Upload & Monitor
tasks.command: ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts/pio run -t clean && ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts/pio run && ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts/pio run -t upload && ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts/pio device monitor

windows.command: ${env:HOMEDRIVE}${env:HOMEPATH}\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe run -t clean ; ${env:HOMEDRIVE}${env:HOMEPATH}\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe run ; ${env:HOMEDRIVE}${env:HOMEPATH}\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe run -t upload ; ${env:HOMEDRIVE}${env:HOMEPATH}\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe device monitor
